headline: North Korea Hackers Move $63 Million in Stolen Ether from Binance Exploit
summary: North Korea's TraderTraitor cyber syndicate moved 34,279 ETH worth approximately $63 million to three new blockchain wallets after two weeks of inactivity following the Binance exploit.
why: Major movements of stolen cryptocurrency by state-backed actors create market supply overhangs and intensify international regulatory scrutiny over crypto security.

impacts.name: Ethereum
impacts.why: The movement of 34,279 stolen ether to active wallets creates liquidation concerns among traders.
